During the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Imperial Era/Legends|reign]], a '''Tsyklen''' from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tsyk]] became an expert in the [[Forger (profession)/Legends|forgery]] of false identifications. A round, [[Hair/Legends|hairless]] individual with taut skin, she had on each of her [[Limb/Legends|hands]] seven fingers slender enough to be mistaken for tentacles, as well as two opposable thumbs. The [[Tsyklen]]'s anatomy made her well suited to her profession, with her wide [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] providing excellent vision and her hands allowing her to operate two [[holo-scriber]]s at once while forging.<ref name="HG" />

In [[5 BBY/Legends|5 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' states that ''[[The Hutt Gambit]]'' is set in [[5 BBY/Legends|5 BBY]].</ref> she lived on the planet [[Nar Hekka]] within [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]], where she was considered the best identification forger available. The [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] found her by asking around [[Cantina/Legends|taverns]] on Nar Hekka, and requested that she forge identifications for him and his partner, [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]]. Giving them the false names Garris Kyll and Arrikabukk, respectively, she charged them a large sum of [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] for the service.<ref name="HG" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Tsyklen forger first appeared in the [[A. C. Crispin]] novel ''[[The Hutt Gambit]]'', released in [[1997]] as the second part of [[The Han Solo Trilogy (hardcover)|''The Han Solo Trilogy'']].<ref name="HG" />
